answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can submit work, then slash that stake when independent audits confirm a duplicate identity or coordinated abuse. A Sybil operator must fund every persona, so multiplying accounts ties up real capital and makes detected attacks costly rather than free. Auditors can publish a cipher-like commitment to evidence, letting others verify claims without exposing private data; a confirmed case creates a ripple of checks across linked accounts, not a fable of effortless anonymity.
